turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: Good choice. And when would you like to pick it up?

turns.text: That's no problem, we've still got medium vans free that weekend. What time would suit you?

turns.text: OK, 8.30 it is. That still gives us most of the day.

turns.text: Great. Now, we also need the address you're moving to, for our insurance.

turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: Thank you. Is that the one near the hospital?

turns.text: That's right, just behind it. It's only about ten minutes from my old place, actually.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: Handy. And could I have a contact number, in case we need to get hold of you?
turns.speaker: staff

turns.say: Yes, my mobile is oh seven seven oh oh, nine oh oh, three two six. Oh, sorry, I always mix that up. The last part is 362.
turns.text: Yes, my mobile is 07700 900 326. Oh, sorry, I always mix that up. The last part is 362.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.say: So that's oh seven seven oh oh, nine oh oh, three six two. Got it.
turns.text: So that's 07700 900 362. Got it.
turns.speaker: staff

turns.say: Now, how much will it cost? I saw on your website that the medium van was sixty-five pounds a day.
turns.text: Now, how much will it cost? I saw on your website that the medium van was £65 a day.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.say: That's our weekday price, I'm afraid. At weekends it's a bit more, so it'd be seventy-five pounds for the Saturday. But if you keep it until Sunday, we do a special deal.
turns.text: That's our weekday price, I'm afraid. At weekends it's a bit more, so it'd be £75 for the Saturday. But if you keep it until Sunday, we do a special deal.
turns.speaker: staff

turns.text: Actually, I might need it on Sunday as well, to take some old furniture to the tip.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.say: In that case, the weekend rate is one hundred and ten pounds for both days, which works out cheaper than paying for two separate days.
turns.text: In that case, the weekend rate is £110 for both days, which works out cheaper than paying for two separate days.
turns.speaker: staff

turns.text: Right, that sounds fine. Let's do that.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.say: Lovely. Would you like any extras? We hire out trolleys for eight pounds, and furniture blankets for five pounds.
turns.text: Lovely. Would you like any extras? We hire out trolleys for £8, and furniture blankets for £5.
turns.speaker: staff

turns.text: I've already borrowed a trolley from my neighbour, so I won't need one. But the blankets would be useful. I don't want to scratch anything.
turns.speaker: caller

turns.say: I'll add those to the booking. Now, there's also a deposit, which you get back when the van's returned without any damage. It used to be two hundred pounds, but it's now one hundred and fifty pounds.
turns.text: I'll add those to the booking. Now, there's also a deposit, which you get back when the van's returned without any damage. It used to be £200, but it's now £150.
turns.speaker: staff

turns.text: OK, that's not too bad. And what do I need to bring with me when I collect it?
turns.speaker: caller

turns.speaker: staff
